exposure.needed: whether the operator intends to switch an existing veth-based deployment to the netkit datapath mode (the evidence names no configuration key that selects netkit)

consequence.statement: Netkit is an optional new datapath mode and veth remains the default, so an operator who does nothing sees no change. Switching an existing deployment from veth to netkit cannot be done in place.

assertion.statement: Starting with Cilium 1.16 netkit is supported as a new datapath mode for Linux kernels of version 6.8 or newer

evidence.excerpt:
* Starting with Cilium 1.16 netkit is supported as a new datapath mode for Linux kernels of
  version 6.8 or newer. Cilium still continues to rely on veth devices by default. In case
  of interest to experiment with netkit, please consider the performance_tuning guide
  for instructions. An in-place replacement of veth to netkit is not possible.
